# Repository-wide Copilot instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` and `agent-context.json` before substantive work.

`AGENTS.md` is canonical. GitHub Issues are the task registry; a draft PR into the integration branch is the visible concurrency claim. Check open Issues and draft PRs before coding, run baseline tests, and do not duplicate overlapping claimed work.

Never fabricate tests, sources, APIs, files, or external state. Model consensus is not evidence. Follow all stricter repository-specific truth, provenance, safety, and handoff rules in `AGENTS.md`.
